questions.q: Who came every day to treat Black Beauty while he was ill?
choices: Mr. Bond, the horse-doctor
Dr. White
The squire
James Howard
questions.evidence: Mr. Bond, the horse-doctor, came every day

questions.q: Why were Ginger and Merrylegs moved into the other stable?
choices: So Beauty could be quiet while he had a fever
So they would not catch Beauty's sickness
Because their stable was being painted
Because they kept fighting
questions.evidence: Ginger and Merrylegs had been moved into the other stable, so that I might be quiet

questions.q: How was Joe feeling, according to his father Tom Green?
choices: Broken-hearted and sure it was all his fault
Angry at John for blaming him
Happy that Beauty was getting better
Bored with his stable work

questions.q: Why did John say he had been hard on Joe?
choices: Beauty was the pride of his heart and he was sore about it
He thought Joe was a bad boy
Joe had been lazy for weeks
The master told him to be strict
questions.evidence: that horse is the pride of my heart

questions.q: John and Tom talk about "ignorance." What does ignorance mean in this chapter?
choices: Not knowing what is right or safe to do
Being mean on purpose
Being too tired to work
Being very brave
questions.evidence: Oh! I did not know, I did not mean any harm

questions.q: What is John's main point about ignorance?
choices: Not knowing can cause as much harm as being wicked
Ignorance is fine if you mean well
Only children are ignorant
Ignorance never hurts anyone
questions.evidence: it is the worst thing in the world, next to wickedness

questions.q: What happened to Tom's plants when the young ladies left the hothouse door open?
choices: The frosty wind killed his tender cuttings
Goats got in and ate them
They grew too fast
The rain washed them away
questions.evidence: there was not one of the tender cuttings that was not nipped off

questions.q: What happened to Beauty after the medicine did its work that night?
choices: He fell asleep and felt much better in the morning
He got worse and needed the doctor again
He was taken out for a gallop
He was moved to Merrylegs' stall
questions.evidence: in the morning I felt much better
